title: SymbolicPatternReasoning LabelNoiseCeiling

stats.done_summary: Completed SPR_BENCH classification analysis. Trained multiple ML models (Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, SVM, KNN, MLP) with various feature representations (label encoding, one-hot encoding, engineered features). Best test accuracy: 55.3% (MLP 256-128-64 with engineered features), significantly below the 70% SOTA baseline. Analysis reveals evidence of a label noise ceiling - all models converge to ~50-55% accuracy regardless of architecture, with severe overfitting (train ~100%, test ~50%). The task demonstrates the challenges of symbolic pattern reasoning under inherent label noise. Report with methodology, results, figures, and discussion delivered at report/report.md.
